question: For all cards illustrated by Jim Pavelec. and describe the text of the ruling of these cards. Do these cards have missing or degraded properties and values.
evidence: all cards illustrated by Jim Pavelec refers to artist = 'Jim Pavelec'; the text of the ruling refers to text; cards have missing or degraded properties and values if hasContentWarning = 1 else it doesn't have;
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching rulings record.
gold: SELECT T2.text, CASE WHEN T1.hasContentWarning = 1 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END FROM cards AS T1 LEFT JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid WHERE T1.artist = 'Jim Pavelec'
gold0: SELECT T2.text , CASE WHEN T1.hasContentWarning = 1 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid WHERE T1.artist = 'Jim Pavelec'

b.request: For every card whose artist is 'Jim Pavelec', list the text of its rulings (including cards with no matching rulings record, via a left join from cards to rulings) and indicate whether the card has missing or degraded properties and values (hasContentWarning = 1 means yes, otherwise no)
b.sql: SELECT r.text, CASE WHEN c.hasContentWarning = 1 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS hasContentWarning FROM cards c LEFT JOIN rulings r ON c.uuid = r.uuid WHERE c.artist = 'Jim Pavelec'

c.sql: SELECT r.text, CASE WHEN c.hasContentWarning = 1 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS has_missing_or_degraded_properties FROM cards c LEFT JOIN rulings r ON c.uuid = r.uuid WHERE c.artist = 'Jim Pavelec'

d.request: For all cards illustrated by Jim Pavelec (artist = 'Jim Pavelec'), give the text of their rulings (the `text` field) and say whether each card has missing or degraded properties and values (hasContentWarning = 1 means it does, otherwise it doesn't). Also keep cards that have no matching rulings record.
d.sql: SELECT r.text, CASE WHEN c.hasContentWarning = 1 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS has_content_warning FROM cards c LEFT JOIN rulings r ON r.uuid = c.uuid WHERE c.artist = 'Jim Pavelec'
